"""Read-only forensic custody of the root deadline barrier failure."""
from __future__ import annotations

import collections
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import re
import stat
import subprocess
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path('/workspace/e02-B-current-coordination')
RAW = ROOT / '.polisyos/e02-B-current/raw/review'
FIXTURE = RAW / 'final-B-cohort-pytest/test_workflow_cas_wait_cannot_1'
SHA = '4e7a4924e6466e1b4eaa39b504435a1243aeb90b'
TREE = '9beb525a5dfd68a610ceb719d4f5b802c3da0e2c'
NODE = 'tests/unit/scientist/orchestration/engine/test_workflow_deadline_custody.py::test_workflow_cas_wait_cannot_admit_late_ref_or_next_producer[deadline-scientist.experiment_state]'
SOURCE_PATHS = [
    'policy-engine/tests/unit/scientist/orchestration/engine/test_workflow_deadline_custody.py',
    'policy-engine/src/polisyos/scientist/orchestration/engine/async_executor.py',
    'policy-engine/src/polisyos/core/artifacts/async_store.py',
    'policy-engine/src/polisyos/common/async_tools.py',
    'policy-engine/src/polisyos/core/run/context.py',
    'policy-engine/src/polisyos/core/artifacts/store.py',
]


def git(*args: str) -> bytes:
    return subprocess.check_output(['/usr/bin/git', *args], cwd=ROOT)


def file_ref(path: Path) -> dict:
    data = path.read_bytes()
    return {'path': str(path), 'bytes': len(data), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()}


def census() -> tuple[list, list]:
    files, directories = [], []
    for path in sorted(FIXTURE.rglob('*')):
        info = path.lstat()
        relative = str(path.relative_to(FIXTURE))
        if stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode):
            directories.append(relative)
            continue
        assert stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode), relative
        files.append({**file_ref(path), 'relative_path': relative, 'kind': 'regular', 'mode': oct(stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode)), 'inode': info.st_ino, 'mtime_ns': info.st_mtime_ns})
    return files, directories


head_before = git('rev-parse', 'HEAD').decode().strip()
tree_before = git('rev-parse', 'HEAD^{tree}').decode().strip()
status_before = git('status', '--porcelain=v1').decode()
files, directories = census()
assert len(files) == 38 and len(directories) == 37
counts = collections.Counter('blob' if row['relative_path'].endswith('.blob') else 'manifest' if row['relative_path'].endswith('.manifest.json') else 'lock' if row['relative_path'].endswith('.lock') else 'trace' if row['relative_path'].endswith('.jsonl') else 'other' for row in files)
assert dict(counts) == {'lock': 10, 'blob': 9, 'manifest': 18, 'trace': 1}
trace_path = FIXTURE / 'cas/runs/R_deadline/trace.jsonl'
trace = trace_path.read_text()
events = [json.loads(line) for line in trace.splitlines()]
assert len(events) == 1 and events[0]['event'] == 'RUN_STARTED'
assert events[0]['refs'] == {'inputs': [], 'outputs': []}
artifacts = []
for path in sorted((FIXTURE / 'cas/artifacts/sha256').rglob('*.blob')):
    data = path.read_bytes()
    digest = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
    assert path.name == digest + '.blob'
    manifest_path = path.with_name(digest + '.manifest.json')
    manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text())
    assert manifest['artifact_id'] == 'sha256:' + digest
    assert manifest['integrity']['sha256'] == digest
    assert manifest['byte_size'] == len(data)
    views = sorted(path.parent.glob(digest + '.view.*.manifest.json'))
    assert len(views) == 1
    assert json.loads(views[0].read_text()) == manifest
    artifacts.append({'artifact_id': manifest['artifact_id'], 'kind': manifest['kind'], 'actual_blob': file_ref(path), 'default_manifest': file_ref(manifest_path), 'selected_view': file_ref(views[0]), 'selected_view_profile_hex_from_filename': views[0].name.split('.view.', 1)[1].removesuffix('.manifest.json'), 'manifest_byte_size': manifest['byte_size'], 'actual_digest_matches_id_integrity_and_size': True, 'default_view_json_equal': True, 'literal_manifest': manifest})
assert len(artifacts) == 9
kinds = dict(sorted(collections.Counter(a['kind'] for a in artifacts).items()))
assert kinds.get('scientist.workflow_spec') == 1
assert set(kinds) == {'scientist.workflow_spec', 'core.registry_bundle', 'ir.slot_registry', 'ir.merge_rule_registry', 'ir.constraint_registry', 'ir.mechanism_registry', 'ir.selector_field_registry', 'ir.metric_registry', 'ir.units_registry'}
source_refs = []
for path in SOURCE_PATHS:
    data = git('show', f'{SHA}:{path}')
    assert data == (ROOT / path).read_bytes(), path
    source_refs.append({'path': path, 'sha': SHA, 'tree': TREE, 'git_blob': git('rev-parse', f'{SHA}:{path}').decode().strip(), 'bytes': len(data), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(), 'current_worktree_bytes_equal_frozen_git': True})
log = (RAW / 'final-B-cohort.txt').read_text()
lines = log.splitlines(keepends=True)
assert log.count('Task exception was never retrieved') == 1
assert log.count("future: <Task finished name='Task-2200'") == 1
warning_start = next(i for i, line in enumerate(lines) if 'Task exception was never retrieved' in line)
warning_end = next(i for i in range(warning_start, len(lines)) if lines[i].startswith('polisyos.scientist.orchestration.engine.errors.WorkflowTimeoutError:'))
warning = ''.join(lines[warning_start:warning_end + 1])
assert warning_start + 1 == 18486 and warning_end + 1 == 18538
assert 'Workflow deadline expired during scientist.workflow_spec' in warning
nearest_header = next((i + 1, lines[i].strip()) for i in range(warning_start, -1, -1) if re.match(r'^_{3,}', lines[i]))
xml = ET.parse(RAW / 'final-B-cohort.xml')
module_cases = []
failed_case = None
for case in xml.iter('testcase'):
    if case.attrib.get('classname', '').endswith('test_workflow_deadline_custody'):
        outcome = 'FAIL' if case.find('failure') is not None or case.find('error') is not None else 'SKIP' if case.find('skipped') is not None else 'PASS'
        module_cases.append({**case.attrib, 'outcome': outcome})
    if case.attrib.get('name') == NODE.split('::')[1] and case.attrib.get('classname', '').endswith('test_workflow_deadline_custody'):
        assert failed_case is None
        failed_case = case
assert failed_case is not None
failure = failed_case.find('failure')
assert failure is not None
failure_text = failure.text
assert failure_text is not None
assert hashlib.sha256(failure_text.encode()).hexdigest() == '30c76f4a238f287fcca798b8e74765f65873fd0c7cccd72d4dc44fcc185aedc2'
inventory = json.loads((RAW / 'final-B-cohort-inventory.json').read_text())
phase_rows = [row for row in inventory['runtime_phase_reports'] if row['nodeid'] == NODE]
assert [row['when'] for row in phase_rows] == ['setup', 'call', 'teardown']
assert [row['outcome'] for row in phase_rows] == ['passed', 'failed', 'passed']
assert phase_rows[1]['longrepr_sha256'] == hashlib.sha256(failure_text.encode()).hexdigest()
metadata = json.loads((RAW / 'final-B-cohort.json').read_text())
profile = json.loads((RAW / 'final-B-cohort-profile.json').read_text())
assert (metadata['head'], metadata['head_after'], metadata['tree']) == (SHA, SHA, TREE)
assert (profile['sha'], profile['tree']) == (SHA, TREE)
assert metadata['command'] == profile['argv']
assert metadata['output_sha256'] == file_ref(RAW / 'final-B-cohort.txt')['sha256']
assert len(profile['inputs']['test_paths']) == 110
assert NODE.split('::')[0] in profile['inputs']['test_paths']
report = {
    'schema': 'policyos.e02.deadline_failure_readonly_audit.v1',
    'reviewer': '/root/cas_probe', 'observed_utc': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'target_sha': SHA, 'target_tree': TREE, 'native_nodeid': NODE,
    'original_case_outcome': 'FAIL', 'case_junit': failed_case.attrib,
    'original_native_profile_refs': [file_ref(RAW / name) for name in ['final-B-cohort.txt', 'final-B-cohort.xml', 'final-B-cohort.json', 'final-B-cohort-profile.json', 'final-B-cohort-inventory.json', 'final-B-cohort.args']],
    'phase_reports': phase_rows,
    'literal_failure_text': failure_text,
    'actual_module_case_census': {'cases': len(module_cases), 'outcomes': dict(collections.Counter(case['outcome'] for case in module_cases)), 'cases_observed': module_cases},
    'literal_unhandled_task_traceback': {'raw_start_line': warning_start + 1, 'raw_end_line': warning_end + 1, 'text': warning, 'utf8_sha256': hashlib.sha256(warning.encode()).hexdigest(), 'nearest_preceding_failure_header': nearest_header},
    'fixture': {'path': str(FIXTURE), 'regular_file_count': len(files), 'directory_count_excluding_fixture_root': len(directories), 'file_type_counts': dict(counts), 'regular_files': files, 'directory_paths': directories, 'literal_trace_utf8': trace, 'events': events, 'artifact_count': len(artifacts), 'artifact_kind_counts': kinds, 'artifacts': artifacts},
    'source_refs': source_refs,
    'source_path_correlation': [
        'FileSystemCAS.put_json copies opts.kind and dispatches self.put_bytes; target-specific _WriteGateCAS therefore observes real state publication, not a constructor marker.',
        'AsyncWorkflowExecutor.execute installs the one original absolute deadline, awaits workflow_spec before add_input and experiment_state.',
        '_put_workflow_artifact uses the remaining original deadline in asyncio.wait_for and fences returned refs; its TimeoutError handler raises WorkflowTimeoutError only after the absolute owner predicate expires.',
        'The exact captured unhandled task stack ends in execute:214 -> workflow_spec -> outer wait_for -> _guard:2285. This is real preceding-phase owner expiry, not a new per-call timeout.',
        'RunContext.add_input emits RUN_INPUT_ADDED. Complete retained trace contains no such event; fixture contains only setup artifacts and workflow_spec.',
        'The failed body entered.wait false and cleanup finished.wait false occur before task gather, so this failed path leaves its task exception unconsumed; other five barrier cases and remaining module cases observed PASS.',
    ],
    'bounded_verdict': {
        'target_gate_entry_premise': 'NOT_ESTABLISHED; native entered.wait returned False',
        'late_experiment_state_admission_or_publication': 'NOT_OBSERVED in complete retained fixture/trace; no defining target I/O was exercised',
        'preceding_workflow_spec_expiry': 'Actual captured native WorkflowTimeoutError during preceding workflow_spec is source-bound; combined failed-case/cleanup/fixture evidence corroborates this explanation.',
        'direct_task_object_to_fixture_identity': 'NOT_ESTABLISHED; the anonymous unhandled task traceback carries no tmp_path/run_id/task-to-test marker and was interleaved into an unrelated HTTP failure report. Do not use Task-2200 name alone as identity.',
        'p37_criterion_result': 'Original FAIL retained; target-specific late entered-I/O defining property not established by this failed case.',
        'p41_inherited_or_flake_label': 'NOT_ESTABLISHED; no base replay or flake adjudication made.',
        'new_product_bug': 'NOT_ESTABLISHED by this failure; no late target artifact/ref accepted in retained scope.',
    },
    'no_mutations_or_runs': {'product_test_source_changes': False, 'fixture_cleanup_or_modification': False, 'gate_or_product_runtime_replay': False, 'helpers_or_worktrees_created': False},
    'root_at_review': {'head_before': head_before, 'tree_before': tree_before, 'status_before': status_before, 'head_after': git('rev-parse', 'HEAD').decode().strip(), 'tree_after': git('rev-parse', 'HEAD^{tree}').decode().strip(), 'status_after': git('status', '--porcelain=v1').decode(), 'root_mutations_by_auditor': False, 'review_target_is_frozen_git4e7_not_current_metadata_head': True},
}
assert census() == (files, directories)
report['fixture_census_before_after_identical'] = True
print(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
